package.name: valid8_cell_description
package.description:
Valid8 Robot Cell Description Package
Contains the URDF/XACRO description for the Valid8 workcell which includes: - Optical table - Face fixture - Robot mount for UR series robots
Based on Universal Robots ROS 2 custom workcell tutorial: https://docs.universal-robots.com/Universal_Robots_ROS_Documentation/doc/ur_tutorials/
